name: Godrej Agrovet Ltd
title: Godrej Agrovet Ltd - 540743 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 volume-led growth with Animal Nutrition volumes +15% and Crop Care destocking drag; FY27 guided to early double-digit revenue and mid-teens PBT growth, with Crop Care recovery and ROCE up to 20%.

capex.quote: we should be left with around INR100 crores, INR125 crores kind of cash surplus which will be there

triggers.label: Crop Care co-marketing inventory carry-forward
triggers.quote: due to carry forward of inventory in the co-marketing channel, leading to lower volumes of in-house products

triggers.label: FY27 PBT growth mid-teens
triggers.quote: we'd like to again target a let's say a mid-strong double-digit, mid-teens kind of a PBT growth also for the next year

triggers.label: Animal Nutrition Q4 volumes +15%
triggers.quote: quarter 4 volumes growing 15% year-on-year, significantly ahead of industry growth

triggers.label: Capex ~INR350-400 cr, 75-80% growth
triggers.quote: Roughly around 75% to 80% of that capex will be growth capex for us

guidance.quote: we'd like to focus on getting an early double-digit revenue growth across put together at a consol level
we'd like to again target a let's say a mid-strong double-digit, mid-teens kind of a PBT growth also for the next year
We'd like to again go for a double -digit growth in revenue led by volume in Animal Nutrition business
So I think we should aim around 15% of growth in terms of the top line
looking for another year of double -digit volume growth in oil palm, early double-digit
our capex requirements would be in the coming years we have pretty much first of all out of our overall capex would be in the range of around 350-odd crores
we'll keep the CDMO percentage going well in the range of around, you know, 52 % to 53% plus kind of salience
Our Broad direction is that we would like this business to have roughly around 50 % to 55% of its portfolio over a period of maybe FY31
